name: Tohju AI Shopping Assistant
author: Tohju Dev

sections.description:
Create multiple AI Agent Chatbots to manage your store and talk to your customers. This plugin seamlessly integrates powerful AI chatbot agents to enhance customer service by providing instant responses, managing queries, and enhancing user engagement.

Acknowledgements

Special thanks to @k0d3d and the open-source community for their invaluable input and support.
sections.installation:
REQUIRED: You need an account on Tohju.com.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the settings under the ‘Settings’ menu.
sections.faq:
How do I create an account?

You can create an account by navigating to app.tohju.com/register.

How do I set up my chatbots?

You can set up your chatbots by creating a new AI agent on tohju.com. Watch videos on our youtube channel. Youtube

Can I customize the chatbot’s responses?

Yes, you can upload FAQs, Shipping Policies and other documents to better match your business needs.
